eng.title: Columbia Undergraduate Admissions - English Proficiency Requirements

test_policy.notes: Test-optional for the 2026-27 cycle (fall 2027 entry). Columbia will require SAT or ACT from the 2027-28 cycle (August 2027 onward), with hardship waivers available.

requirements.notes: Columbia-specific application questions are required. Engineering applicants need one math or science teacher recommendation. Interviews are not part of the admissions process (FAQ).

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Decisions mid-December (no exact date published); admitted students respond by mid-January.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions late March (no exact date published); reply by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Not needed if your home language is English, your primary language of instruction was English for all of secondary school, or you scored 700+ on SAT Reading and Writing or 29+ on ACT English or Reading.

english.notes: Exams taken on or before 2026-01-20. MyBest scores not accepted.
IELTS Academic or Academic for UKVI.

aid.notes: Columbia meets the full demonstrated need of admitted first-years and has no merit scholarships. US citizens are need-blind; the international page notes that aid-seeking international candidates can fall outside the need-blind category, i.e. need-aware.

majors.notes: Applicants choose either Columbia College or Columbia Engineering (cannot apply to both).

pte.note: PTE is not listed among Columbia's accepted English proficiency exams.

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Columbia Business School is graduate-only).
tier_notes.nursing: No first-year nursing entry (Columbia nursing is for graduate / second-degree students).
tier_notes.computer_science: Top-15 CS department in Columbia Engineering.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-10 life sciences linked to a major medical center.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes and research access through Columbia's medical center.
tier_notes.humanities: Core Curriculum and top-10 humanities departments.
tier_notes.engineering: Solid engineering school, below the top-15 group.
